ITEM 1 | Orange-red sweet potato-like slices, roughly 1 cm thick, cut into wedges and half-moons with a smooth, slightly glossy skin edge and a bright orange interior, some pieces showing light browning and caramelized edges, lying along the left side of the plate, one dark charred piece at the bottom | 85
ITEM 2 | Shredded brown meat with stringy fibers and irregular clumps, moist-looking with darker browned bits and a few flecks of green and red herb or pepper, piled in a mound about 8 cm long and 5 cm wide, sitting between the orange slices and the greens | 110
ITEM 3 | Chopped pale green leafy vegetable, crisp-looking pieces with ruffled edges and lighter yellowish-white ribs, coated with a creamy, pale off-white dressing that gives a slightly glossy, clinging sheen, mounded in a pile about 10 cm across and 3 cm tall on the right side of the plate | 90
